risks.risk: PS4 model mismatch (could be PS4 Slim/Fat instead of Pro). This changes value.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the console model label/serial sticker (or the Settings > System > System Information screen showing model/region).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-verified model (worst case: treat as a non-Pro PS4 bundle similar to the cheapest PS4 listings with games/pads).

risks.risk: Games may not be included as claimed (could be fewer games, or only installed without discs, or some may be corrupted).
risks.proof: Ask for a screenshot/clip of the PS4 'Library' showing installed games count (10) and titles, or photos of the 10 game discs/cases.
risks.if_unproven: Price as fewer/uncertain games (worst case: treat as minimal value bundle).

risks.risk: Controllers may be missing/defective (sticks drift, buttons not working, charging issues).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing both controllers connected and working (button test / moving in a game menu) and charging indicator.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers not guaranteed working (worst case: treat as needing replacement).

risks.risk: Console condition/health (overheating, loud fan, HDMI/USB ports issues).
risks.proof: Ask for a video booting to the home screen plus a quick test of HDMI output and at least one USB port.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested (worst case: assume possible faults).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the console model label/serial sticker (to confirm PS4 Pro vs Slim/Fat and region).
Screenshot/clip of PS4 Library showing exactly 10 installed games (titles visible).
Video showing both controllers connected and fully working (button/joystick movement) and charging.
Video booting to home screen and quick test of HDMI + USB ports.
response.reason: The photo does not clearly confirm the PS4 Pro model, storage, or the claimed 10 games and two working controllers. Without these, a worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the correct comparable range.
